config.label: auto (default) shows the session in the chat when the client supports MCP Apps, and opens the browser otherwise
config.description: auto (default) shows the session in the chat when the client supports MCP Apps, and opens the browser otherwise. on always answers for the chat view. off never does.

config.label: Set to true to also save the session page when the session is shown in the chat
config.description: Set to true to also save the session page when the session is shown in the chat.

config.label: Used when the session is not shown in the chat
config.description: Used when the session is not shown in the chat. Set to false to stop new sessions opening in the default browser. The file path is returned either way.

config.label: Folder for session pages
config.description: Folder for session pages. Defaults to a VirWave Breathe folder in the system temp directory.
